source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

original_test_intent: Verify the temperature record named `TEMP CEMBB` represents the intended platform CEMBB assembly sensing point and is human-readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with the correct value, units, status and supported thresholds for the Project specification.
original_method: Confirm the platform-defined expansion and hardware identity of CEMBB, resolve the stable record and physical probe zone on the exact assembly revision, then compare complete passive raw and unchanged UI fields with the approved limits or non-intrusive reference under recorded CEM population, load and airflow. Preserve logs and hardware state.
manual_activity: The platform owner defines CEMBB, identifies the exact assembly/revision and probe zone, and chooses static range/status or calibrated-reference acceptance. Automation can collect the single stable record and both UI views; a human verifies acronym/location/reference interpretation and owns the verdict. No card/riser service or cooling change is authorized.
required_inputs: Project definition of CEMBB plus exact chassis/board/CEM assembly PN/revision and BMC/BIOS identity
Authoritative drawing locating the CEMBB sensor and its thermal zone relative to slots, cards, risers and airflow
Stable SDR name/number/type/entity/instance and corresponding Dashboard and Server Health rows
Expected units, scaling/rounding, static range or reference delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, unavailable and freshness semantics
CEM slot/riser/card population, card power/load state, fan mode/speeds, panels/ducts, airflow and timestamp alignment
If accuracy is required, approved non-intrusive calibrated reference placement, combined uncertainty and BMC update-lag rule
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions, protected authentication and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or system logs; CEM/PCIe, fan and thermal history is relevant to interpreting the assembly temperature.
Do not expand CEMBB as backboard, backplane or baseboard solely from the label. Use the Project assembly map and keep alternative meanings explicit until confirmed.
Do not substitute a CEM-slot or add-in-card internal sensor for CEMBB. Prove the assembly/probe source and preserve corroborating card telemetry separately.

Do not remove/reseat CEM cards or risers, open panels/ducts, change fan policy, generate load, obstruct airflow or alter thresholds. These actions can change the measured zone and are outside this passive row.
Distinguish specification-range/status evidence from calibrated accuracy. Any reference probe must be non-intrusive and placed by an approved method that does not change airflow.

Do not truncate inventory, expose passwords using `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the unavailable internal Script. Stop without automatic retry on duplicate identity, stale data or raw/UI/reference disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, CEMBB definition, assembly revision/probe zone, CEM population, client and Script; establish static-versus-reference acceptance before collection.
Capture the complete raw/API record and unchanged Dashboard plus Server Health rows with identity, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamps.
Record slot/riser/card population, card load/power, fan/panel/airflow state and compare with versioned limits; add only an approved non-intrusive time-aligned reference.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, hardware service, card load/reset, chassis/airflow/fan/threshold change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Define CEMBB for this platform and approve the exact assembly/revision, probe zone and relationship to CEM slots/cards.
Define static range/status versus calibrated-accuracy acceptance, thresholds, tolerance, freshness and any safe reference placement, and approve the tool/Script.
Review raw, UI and optional reference evidence under the recorded CEM/cooling configuration and issue the formal verdict with coverage limitations.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal query can retrieve a record if that exact spaced name exists, but cannot prove the CEMBB assembly meaning/location, CEM population and cooling/reference conditions or UI/spec agreement. The truncated fallback, credential exposure and assumed cipher further weaken it.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve TEMP CEMBB through complete inventory and the approved assembly/probe map, retrieve it via protected read-only access, capture both UI paths and compare against the named passive range or non-intrusive reference under a documented CEM/cooling state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP CEMBB, Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review resolves platform semantics without editing Master or changing hardware/airflow.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate a stable SDR identity and both UI rows with the versioned CEMBB assembly/probe map, document CEM population/load and cooling state, then apply approved static limits or a non-intrusive synchronized reference with an uncertainty model.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis/CEMBB assembly/riser/card/cooling configuration and BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board/CEMBB/riser revisions, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, card inventory/firmware/driver, fan policy, management client, optional instrument calibration and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: CEMBB assembly definition and sensor-placement drawing, CEM/riser/card topology, platform thermal/SDR limits, airflow specification, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds acronym and assembly-level identity, CEM population/cooling context and an explicit static-versus-accuracy criterion while preserving the passive sensor/UI check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One passive CEMBB value does not validate each CEM slot/card temperature, PCIe device functionality, response to load, threshold events, fan control or protection behavior; static range is not calibrated accuracy.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: CEMBB definition/assembly/probe map, range or reference acceptance, thresholds/freshness, CEM/cooling-state record, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CEMBB may be vendor-specific; assembly and card population alter spatial gradients, intrusive probe placement changes airflow, and UI rounding/update delay can cause benign differences.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM telemetry as an approved alternative to ipmitool only with the original method preserved, interface/version and reason recorded, engineer approval and equivalent CEMBB assembly identity, value, threshold, status and freshness evidence. CEM-slot, add-in-card or generic chassis temperatures are not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Project-approved CEMBB definition; chassis/board/CEMBB assembly PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and CEM slot/riser/card population identity
Authoritative sensor-placement/thermal-zone map and complete raw record with stable ID, value, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamp
Redacted Dashboard and Server Health evidence mapped to the same assembly sensor
Card/riser load/power, fan speeds/policy, panels/ducts and airflow state with synchronized timestamps
Approved static-range comparison or non-intrusive calibrated reference samples with placement, uncertainty and update-lag calculation
Pinned Script/tool security evidence, no-clear/no-write/no-hardware-or-airflow-change/no-retry proof, final PCIe/cooling/BMC health, limitations and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The vendor acronym is underdefined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently call for passive validation of one named temperature record. Project documentation can resolve the assembly meaning and acceptance, so this is readiness uncertainty rather than an irreducible source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The named record and passive display/specification purpose are identifiable. CEMBB expansion, assembly/probe map and criteria can be supplied by the Project, so missing inputs do not create a permanent blocker.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic CEM slot/card temperature or a guessed acronym expansion from being accepted as CEMBB coverage and prevents an intrusive reference setup from changing the thermal zone under test.
independent_technical_reasoning: `CEMBB` is a platform label whose expansion and assembly cannot be safely inferred. The key distinction is whether it denotes a dedicated board-level thermal zone rather than any slot or card sensor. Meaningful passive evidence therefore needs the exact assembly revision, probe location, CEM population and cooling state; calibrated accuracy requires a non-intrusive reference, while no hardware manipulation is authorized.
